course.title: Troubleshoot a sign-in problem
course.practice: Work through a fictional support ticket. A Microsoft 365 sign-in fails on Windows 11. Ask what error the user saw and who is affected, then suggest a safe first check.
course.check: Record the symptom, action and result in the ticket. Keep credentials private and escalate unresolved issues to the right team.

course.title: Run a small web app with React and Docker
course.practice: Display three fictional records in a React list and run the application in a prepared container.
course.check: Ask someone else to follow your setup instructions and confirm they can open the app and see all three records.

course.title: Check and summarize CSV data with Python
course.practice: Read a fictional CSV, flag missing values and count valid records for each group.
course.check: Verify the row totals and report missing records separately.
